name: Errand
description: Errand runs your errands in Naira from your own wallet. You keep USD₮ in your own Altana wallet and grant Errand a session with an onchain spend cap, a list of the only contracts it may call, and an expiry, revocable in one transaction. Errand plans each errand, checks every payment with its guard, converts USD₮ to cNGN on Textile FX, pays the named recipient, and returns a receipt with a Celoscan link for every transaction. Errand Guard (coming) lets other agents pay over x402 to have a payment checked; Self Agent ID decides which agents get served.
